description: Overview Named after the elementary particle that binds quarks together inside atomic nuclei, QuantumGluon builds the optical hardware, quantum memory payloads, and orbital routing protocols required to extend the quantum internet beyond Earth's atmosphere. While terrestrial networks rely on fiber optics that lose quantum signals after a few hundred kilometers, QuantumGluon leverages the near-vacuum of space to distribute quantum entanglement across cislunar and deep-space distances.
